# metricool-client

> Typed Python client core for the Metricool API: schedule posts, page through comments, export them to CSV with formula-injection protection Python package `trysac-metricool-client`, import name `metricool_client`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
